dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: I am the account manager here at the Northland Bank. Feel free to find me for help with any matters you'd like to take care of in the bank.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: If you're interested in a loan, I can assure you that our interest rates are better than any of the local lenders you'll find around Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: You'll also find our savings accounts much more competitive as well. Our interest return on savings will surely be higher than any local lender!

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: So no matter what your business may be, Northland Bank can always be the first to meet your banking needs!
